decision: Topic: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth (Wed 18 Nov 2026, 10:16 UTC). Publish the same day at 17:00 UTC in the slot Light Travel holds now; move Light Travel to Fri 20 Nov.
rationale: A dated, once-ever milestone with NASA publicity behind it and search demand peaking on the day. It continues our best-performing Sky School topic (Pale Blue Dot / Voyager) and pairs with the Light Travel explainer. Every number comes from one NASA Science page.
alternatives: Post on Tue 17 Nov with the 'Shine Bright' event (but the milestone is not yet reached then)
Skip it as news rather than sky
